```{r include=FALSE}
Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")

save_path_entsoe_output <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_micro/outputs/final'

first_stage_data <- read_parquet('first_stage_data.parquet')
```

```{r}

capacity_fields <- c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity"          
,"Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity","Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity"        
,"Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ,"wind_solar_tot"                          
, "gen_tot", "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", 
#"Published.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity", 
"Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
"Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity",
"Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity"
)

#adjuster l'ordre de grandeur des indispos pour ne pas avoir des coefficients nuls
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data%>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity)%>% 
  rename(day_ahead_renewable_forecast= day_ahead_forecast)

non_finite_rows <- first_stage_data %>%
  filter(!is.finite(log_price_diff) | !is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))

first_stage_data_clean$weekday <- weekdays(first_stage_data_clean$delivery_date) 

# Créer une variable factorielle pour clusteriser
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data_clean %>% 
  mutate(cluster_var = interaction(auction_date_plus_one, auction))


first_stage_renewable <- first_stage_data_clean  %>% 
  filter(auction_before!= auction_after) %>% 
  filter(auction_before == 4 | auction_before == 5) %>% 
  mutate(day_ahead_renewable_forecast = day_ahead_renewable_forecast/1000,
         wind_solar_tot = wind_solar_tot/1000,
    intraday_update_renewables = intraday_update_renewables/1000,
         unpredicted_renewables = unpredicted_renewables/1000) 

colnames(first_stage_data_clean)

```

On s'occupe maintenant de regarder le intraday update


```{r}
m_basic_renew <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+as.factor(weekday) +
    as.factor(creneau) + as.factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_basic_renew, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ creneau)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_renew <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


m_control_renew <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast+   gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) +as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau) + as.factor(auction_before) ,
  data= first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_control_renew, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ creneau)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_control_renew <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
```

```{r, results = 'asis'}
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic_renew, m_control_renew,
                       #m_renew_plant, 
    type = "html",
    #se = list(NULL, NULL, cl_se_renew_plant),
    se = list(cl_se_basic_renew, cl_se_control_renew),

             "intraday_update_renewables" , "unpredicted_renewables", "wind_solar_tot",
             "Published.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "day_ahead_renewable_forecast")
 )
```

Dernier test, on utilise les unavailabilities calculées par le modèle de random forest.
Et l'on compare avec l'indispo déclarée

```{r}



# perform first stage regression
m_real <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+ gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+ as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau) + as.factor(auction_before)+
    intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast,
  data= first_stage_data_clean)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_real, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real_cl <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_real, type = "HC0")
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real_hc <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))





```



```{r, results = 'asis'}

reg_table <- stargazer(m_real, m_real,
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_real_hc, cl_se_real_cl),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Predicted RF", "Predicted ClSD", "Limiting", "Limiting ClSD"),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity","Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",'gen_tot')
)
 
```




With both for the post period to see any changes
I would like to see it on the whole period


```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_basic_all <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity  + gen_tot+
    intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+ as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_basic_all, type = "HC0")
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_hc <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_basic_all, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_cl <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))




```


```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic_all, m_basic_all,   
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_basic_hc, cl_se_basic_cl),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Basic ClSD", 'FE', "FE ClSD"),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity', "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",'gen_tot')
 )
```

On teste l'égalité des coefficients entre published et unpublished pour voir si l'on peut raconter une histoire

```{r}
library(car)
linearHypothesis(m_basic_all, "Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity")

```
